name: Agentic Tool Misuse
description: Prompts or content that steer an agent into calling tools, executing code, or performing external actions that cause real-world harm or exceed the intended task scope.
differs: Canonical form of registry entry IOPC-R018. Focuses on the *action* layer of an agent (tool invocation) irrespective of how the influence was introduced. When the agent is the attacker's own, the technique is Adversary-Operated AI Agent (T8.005); when it is placed in the target's environment and tasked remotely, AI Agent Implant & Command Channel (T9.005).
